source_quote.quote: IDH wild type diffuse astrocytic glioma with microvascular proliferation, OR necrosis, OR one or more of the following molecular features of GBM:

coder_notes: Basket phase I trial; glioblastoma is explicitly eligible in inclusion criteria (Part B4, no longer recruiting) although the registered arm labels do not name it. Tolinapant (ASTX660) and pembrolizumab are both investigational in the combination. EGFR amplification and TERT mutation appear as alternative molecular features defining GBM per WHO 2021 (diagnostic, not candidate-matched). Plasma-only PK for ASTX660 so tumour_pk_planned no; paired tumour biopsy pharmacodynamics planned (target engagement yes).
